Seeds hand-curated from Meridian's services + suburbs; routine re-checks each query against live search results every Saturday, harvests up to 5 new queries per run from Google autocomplete on the seeds that matter, and demotes queries that stop yielding useful signal. See docs/audit-dashboard-setup.md §6. 2026-09-04 (three-week gap since last audit on 2026-08-14 — routine skipped 2026-08-21 and 2026-08-28 runs; only intervening commit was PR #121, a referral-form UX fix, no backlog items shipped): **FOURTH-EVER Meridian ranking + FIRST WIN OUTSIDE THE SPORTS-INJURY-RECOVERY URL** — Meridian's /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ debuts at #4 on 'pregnancy back pain christchurch' in an SERP where triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz holds #1 and osteo.co.nz #2. This is the first ranked query attributable to a condition-page URL OTHER than sports-injury-recovery — 17+ weeks after that condition page shipped, and 12 weeks after its 40-60 word citation-ready intro (item #31) + structured list blocks (item #34) were bundled onto it. Rank-4-10-keeps-priority rule applied to pregnancy back pain (was 5, kept 5), but strict application drops it below the priority-10 tracking floor — bumped to 15 (matching tennis-elbow tracking floor precedent from last run) so the newly-ranking query stays in the check pool. **REGRESSIONS on both new-last-week sports-injury wins**: 'sports injury osteopath christchurch' dropped from #5 to rank 0 (SERP returned to performanceplusphysiochch.co.nz + Better-Health-heavy top 5); 'sports injury recovery christchurch' dropped from #6 to rank 0 (top-10 still all-physio, no Meridian slot). Tennis elbow #9 holds for a THIRD consecutive week — the most durable Meridian ranking on the board. Rank-count trajectory: 0 (weeks 1–17) → 1 (2026-08-07) → 3 (2026-08-14) → 2 this run (tennis elbow + pregnancy back pain). Net-net, the sports-injury-recovery URL's SERP position was more fragile than the first-two-run signal suggested, but the URL-per-condition thesis has now generalised to a SECOND page (pregnancy-back-pain), confirming the pattern is not URL-idiosyncratic. Autocomplete fetch (suggestqueries.google.com) STILL blocked by routine host egress allowlist — 5th consecutive run blocked. Both new adds are derived. Pruned 1 query: 'dry needling halswell' (physio-focused Halswell Clinic + US directories dominate; no plausible NZ path for an osteopathy-based dry-needling service to displace physios on a suburb query). Added 2 derived queries: 'pregnancy pelvic pain christchurch' (extends the newly-validated pregnancy-back-pain URL ranking to test whether it generalises to adjacent pelvic-pain intent) + 'wrist pain osteopath christchurch' (completes the specific-body-part pain-osteo tracking set alongside elbow/hip/knee). Pool at 50/50.
